fee_notes: Initial Fee is greater of $25,000 or $250 per guest room. In 2025, Initial Fees ranged from $12,000 to $25,000. Application Fee of $2,500 credited toward Initial Fee. Relicense Fee for transfers/renewals is greater of $25,000 or $250 per room (2025 actual: $25,000).
raw_excerpt: The Initial Fee for a new construction or conversion Chain Facility is equal to the greater of $25,000 or $250 per guest room. In 2025, our Initial Fees ranged from $12,000 to $25,000.
